newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF barometer rises 0.1 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF barometer rises 0.1 pct in February.

text.p: Switzerland's Centre for Research of Economic Activity (KOF) said its economic barometer rose 0.1 percent in February from January for a year-on-year rise of 0.9 percent.
"The prospects for a slight pickup in the economy in the second half of 1997 thus remain intact," said KOF, part of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH).
In January the barometer had fallen 0.2 percent from the previous month for a year-on-year rise of 0.8 percent
KOF said in a statement that real money supply had again risen in February while the manpower index of job vacancies had shown another decline.
The trend of other indices, such as construction, orders on hand in the machinery industry and employment prospects in industry, had not changed from the previous month, it added.
